cover.title: Fired After Reporting Harassment
cover.subtitle: Reporting your manager to HR should never cost you your job.

situation.label: The Situation
situation.text: You reported your manager to HR for harassment. Two weeks later, you were “laid off.” They called it restructuring, but then hired someone else for your exact role a month later.

point.label: The Truth
point.title: That’s retaliation.
point.note: And it’s one of the most common employment violations we see in Texas.

evidence.label: Your Evidence
evidence.title: The timing alone may be enough to prove your case.
evidence.note: A complaint. A “layoff.” A replacement hire. The dates tell the story.

cta.label: We Can Help
cta.title: Don’t let them get away with it.
cta.note: Contact The Lange Firm before your deadline to file runs out.
